positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Developed a RESTful API leveraging machine learning techniques to deliver solutions to customer issues in a more accurate manner

Integrated the API with existing search systems to impact end users

Created visualizations to display the effectiveness of the results being returned to end users

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Implemented a job scheduling algorithm to minimize network congestion across datacenters
This optimization reduced network use between datacenters by over 90% for a specific, network intensive, type of job

Added checksums to database restores so that clients can ensure the accuracy of the files being sent to them

Increase the frequency of, and reorganized certain types of logs to be more meaningful and allow for faster, more accurate solutions for clients

positions.title: Programmer Intern
positions.description:
Developed a data capture application over a six week period to ensure stock of the correct merchandise based on customer decision making rather than solely on out of stock items

Created a tool to track progress in manufacturing departments to increase efficiency by  decreasing the amount of time managers spent on reporting tasks each week by automating the reporting process

Assisted with debugging of specific customer issues with the eCommerce website improving relations with customers by responding to their needs in a timely manner

Designed web-based, real-time displays for the distribution department, allowing them to see which orders need to be filled when, thus decreasing the number of late shipments
